xiv) Guess the distance you traveled in only the 25th second or only the 35th second.
xv) Think and find the technique to deduce the answer.
To find the distance travelled in the 25th second, we first calculate the distance covered in
25 seconds and then in 24 seconds. Subtracting the distance covered in 24 seconds from the
total distance in 25 seconds yields the answer.
Similarly, to find the distance in the 35th second, we subtract the distance traveled in 34
seconds from the distance in 35 seconds.
